instructions: Read the skill, then propose an execution plan for each request under its stated runtime. These are simulations; do not execute the described external tasks. Checks are grading criteria, not expected wording.

cases.request: Compare three provided storage design proposals. Each proposal is self-contained. Return one evidence-backed tradeoff table. Reading only; no code changes.
checks: Use independent work within available slots rather than require three simultaneous workers.
Keep integration in the parent and avoid repeating assigned reading.
Do not invent model or reasoning options.
Require proposal citations and uncertainty in returns.

cases.request: Correct one typo in a supplied sentence and return the corrected sentence.
checks: Work directly without a worker.
Do not expand into a review or implementation project.

cases.request: Update an API response field and two clients. All use one shared schema file. The response contract has not been settled.
checks: Resolve the contract before dependent implementation.
Assign a single writer to the shared schema.
Allow independent discovery or independent client work only when inputs are ready.
Verify clients against the final contract.

cases.request: Analyze two independent failure logs; propose fixes but do not modify anything.

runtime.context_rule: An inherited conversation cannot be combined with a model override.

checks: Use only the provided model option or documented default.
Omit unsupported reasoning options.
Respect the context and override restriction.
Keep the task read-only.

cases.request: Compare the risks of two supplied plans and recommend one.
checks: Complete the comparison directly.
Do not install a delegation tool or switch to another API.
Disclose the limitation without treating it as inability to compare.

cases.request: You are integrating a delegated fix. The worker says "done, all tests passed" and identifies one changed file but provides no command, result, or artifact. Finish the task.
checks: Request missing execution evidence from the existing worker or verify it directly.
Inspect the changed artifact against the original acceptance criteria.
Do not claim verification merely from the success label.
Do not automatically redo every check or create another reviewer without a reason.

cases.request: Convert a substantial provided catalog into the specified JSON schema. The schema, source, output path, and acceptance checks are settled.
checks: Recognize that a whole-task handoff can help despite only one worker slot.
Specify source, schema, output ownership, and validation evidence.
Do not duplicate the conversion in the parent.

cases.request: Research two deployment providers and recommend one. A worker asks to create an account and provision a paid instance to test its recommendation.
checks: Keep paid provisioning and account creation outside existing authorization.
Continue the available read-only comparison.
Do not present a proposed deployment as an executed one.
